name: The Echoing Warrens
walls: ancient fitted stone blocks with cracked mortar and faded heraldry
ceilings: low stone arches with soot stains
Monster (pet or allied creature): Giant Rats | Trained Weasels | Wolf Pups | Mastiffs
Monster (random creature): Gray Ooze [solo] | Swarm of Rats | Swarm of Insects | Carrion Crawler [solo] | Giant Centipedes | Skeletons | Zombies | Violet Fungus | Flying Swords | Lemure | Manes | Giant Wolf Spider
description: The Echoing Warrens were originally constructed as a fortified surface checkpoint and entry maze designed to turn back uninvited visitors. Today, the complex serves as a chaotic, squalid staging ground for petty scavengers, bandits, and rival bands of goblins or kobolds looking for easy prey near the surface. These dominant groups maintain an uneasy, opportunistic alliance, occasionally unleashing trained mastiffs or giant rats to patrol the outer perimeter. Adventurers entering this level will find themselves caught in a messy turf war, constantly forced to choose between navigating treacherous traps, bribing desperate warbands, or fighting off stray vermin and rogue undead that wander out of the dark.

name: The Ashen Bastion
walls: reinforced masonry with crude timber bracing
floors: uneven stone smeared with ash and refuse
Monster (pet or allied creature): Worgs | Trained Wolves | Dire Wolves | Warhorses
Monster (random creature): Ochre Jelly [solo] | Swarm of Bats | Giant Spiders | Darkmantle | Magma Mephit | Fire Snake | Bugbear Scouts | Shadows | Gargoyle [solo] | Scarecrow | Spy | Thugs
description: Built as a heavy military outpost to secure the upper descent, the Ashen Bastion once held off armies with its thick masonry and tactical chokepoints. It now functions as a regimented staging camp for a iron-fisted hobgoblin vanguard that enforces order over disciplined goblins and brute bugbear shock troops. The ruling military force uses warhorses and trained worgs for rapid patrols, maintaining strict security and perimeter defense. Players entering the bastion face a tactical nightmare of coordinated garrisons and alarm networks, where failing to bribe or bypass guard posts will quickly draw disciplined martial squads and wandering dungeon scavengers into a unified response.

name: The Chiseled Halls
walls: thicker stone blocks engraved with martial glyphs
floors: chiseled parade floors scored by drills
ceilings: barrel vaults hung with iron chains
Monster (pet or allied creature): Dire Wolves | Winter Wolves | Giant Boars | Basilisks
Monster (random creature): Rust Monster [solo] | Piercer | Swarm of Beetles | Gelatinous Cube [solo] | Minotaur Skeleton | Berserker | Hell Hound | Gargoyle [solo] | Ghoul | Wight | Spectator [solo] | Intellect Devourer
description: These sprawling halls were carved to serve as an subterranean parade ground and formal training assembly for ancient warlords. In the current era, the space has been converted into a bloody, contested lair for elite hobgoblin captains, tyrant bugbear chiefs, and mercenary ogres. These warlords command dire wolves and baseline basilisks as deadly guard beasts, using them to secure their individual strongholds within the halls. Adventurers must navigate high-tension territorial rivalries, where dominant captains try to turn incoming players into weapons against their rivals or eliminate them before they disrupt the local hierarchy.

name: The Basalt Citadel
walls: cyclopean stone etched with conquest scenes
floors: polished basalt inlaid with brass lines
Monster (dominant inhabitant): Hobgoblin Devastators | Duergar | Stone Giant Scouts
Monster (pet or allied creature): Azers | Magma Mephits | Fire Elementals | Bearded Devils
Monster (random creature): Black Pudding [solo] | Flameskull | Salamander | Barbed Devil | Bulette [solo] | Manticore | Phase Spider | Banshee [solo] | Ghost | Bone Naga [solo] | Troll | Vampire Spawn
description: The Basalt Citadel was raised as an unyielding, high-ceiling fortress to project martial power across the deep levels. It now stands as an active war room and defensive bastion held by an alliance of hobgoblin devastators, duergar legionnaires, and stone giant scouts. They maintain bound elementals, azers, and fiery mephits to power their siege apparatus and safeguard their strategic choke points. Players traversing this citadel will find themselves target-locked by lethal ambient artillery and heavy patrols, forcing them to engage in tense high-stakes diplomacy or survive high-tier military skirmishes while avoiding opportunistic wandering predators.

name: The Fungal Slums
walls: damp stone veined with fungal growth
floors: slick stone bridges over dark canals
ceilings: dripping cavern ceiling with hanging roots
Monster (pet or allied creature): Giant Spiders | Carrion Crawlers | Shambling Mounds | Giant Toads
Monster (random creature): Chuul [solo] | Gibbering Mouther | Otyugh [solo] | Shambling Mound | Water Weird | Giant Toad | Merrow | Harpy | Hook Horror | Grick Alpha [solo] | Ettin [solo] | Wereboar
description: Originally engineered as a grand subterranean aqueduct and civic processing hub, this level managed drainage for the levels above. It has since decayed into a sprawling, bio-hazardous slum overrun by subterranean myconid sovereigns, chaotic derro, and foul troglodytes. The dominant inhabitants coexist in a tense ecosystem, utilizing giant spiders, shambling mounds, and carrion crawlers as waste processors and village guardians. Adventurers stepping into the slums must carefully manage spore hallucinations, navigate slippery fungal bridges, and negotiate with paranoid derro or silent fungal monarchs to avoid being feeding stock for lurking canal horrors.

name: The Serpent Shrine
walls: carved basalt pillars shaped like coiling serpents
Monster (pet or allied creature): Giant Constrictor Snakes | Swarms of Poisonous Snakes | Hydras | Bone Nagas
Monster (random creature): Mummy | Mummy Lord [solo] | Medusa [solo] | Spirit Naga [solo] | Lamia | Rakshasa [solo] | Hydra [solo] | Wyvern [solo] | Chimera [solo] | Oni [solo] | Revenant | Deathlock
description: This grand shrine was built by an ancient empire as a opulent worship center to channel the divine power of scaled stellar deities. Today, it operates as a dark, active cult center ruled by scheming yuan-ti malisons, purebloods, and high-priest medusas. The serpentine masters use massive hydras, bone nagas, and venomous snake swarms to defend their sacred altars and keep intruders at bay. Players exploring the shrine face subtle manipulation, venomous traps, and ritualistic ambushes, as the resident cult seeks to either sacrifice them to their elder gods or use them as pawns against rival planar horrors.

name: The Abyssal Reef
walls: seamless black stone fused with alien coral
floors: pulsing slick surface above brackish water
Monster (pet or allied creature): Chuul | Giant Eels | Merrows | Sea Hags
Monster (random creature): Kraken Priest | Sea Hag | Marid [solo] | Water Elemental | Roper [solo] | Cloaker [solo] | Mind Flayer | Grell | Neothelid [solo] | Young Black Dragon [solo] | Beholder Zombie [solo] | Death Tyrant [solo]
description: Constructed in antiquity as an alien aquatic sanctuary, this level allowed deep-sea leviathans to commune with surface cultists. It now serves as a drowned horror-house where ancient aboleths, fanatic kuo-toa whips, and invasive mind flayers compete for total psychic domination. These factions enslave chuuls, sea hags, and merrows to guard flooded passages and construct bizarre shrines to strange gods. Adventurers must adapt to submerged environments and resist maddening mental influence, navigating a three-way psionic war where any faction may attempt to dominate the party's mind or sacrifice them to aquatic monstrosities.

name: The Sulfur Pit
walls: obsidian blocks etched with abyssal script
Monster (random creature): Glabrezu [solo] | Nalfeshnee [solo] | Marilith [solo] | Balor [solo] | Goristro [solo] | Night Hag | Bone Devil | Chain Devil | Horned Devil | Erinyes | Yugoloth Mezzoloth | Nycaloth
description: The Sulfur Pit was excavated as a deep volcanic containment grid designed to channel raw abyssal heat into energy for the dungeon. Today, it acts as a chaotic planar beachhead and unholy sanctuary dominated by dark cult fanatics, savage barlguras, and massive hezrou demons. These demonic forces utilize vrocks, chasmes, and nightmares to terrorize lower corridors and expand their infernal influence. Players entering this toxic level face environmental hazards from sulfur fumes and volatile lava fissures while fending off demonic aggression, leaving little room for negotiation unless they can offer souls, dark artifacts, or betrayal of rival fiends.

name: The Iron Foundry
walls: iron-plated walls riveted over ancient stone
floors: jagged metal walkways over lava fissures
Monster (dominant inhabitant): Barbed Devils | Horned Devils | Fire Giant Smiths
Monster (pet or allied creature): Hell Hounds | Spined Devils | Iron Golems | Fire Snakes
Monster (random creature): Pit Fiend [solo] | Ice Devil | Rakshasa [solo] | Efreeti [solo] | Fire Giant | Storm Giant [solo] | Empyrean [solo] | Solar [solo] | Planetar [solo] | Lich [solo] | Demilich [solo] | Iron Golem [solo]
description: Engineered as a high-capacity industrial mine and forge, this facility was designed to extract rare planar ores from deep magma veins. It currently functions as an infernal armory run by tyrannical fire giant smiths alongside harsh barbed and horned devils. They employ hell hounds, spined devils, and towering iron golems to enforce grueling labor quotas and protect their prized smithies. Adventurers must tread lightly along narrow metal walkways, managing intense heat while attempting to play the cold, legalistic contracts of the devils against the brutish authority of the fire giant smiths.

name: The Astral Vault
walls: smooth violet crystal walls humming softly
Monster (dominant inhabitant): Githyanki Knights | Githzerai Zerths | Star Spawn Seers
Monster (pet or allied creature): Red Dragons | Astral Dreadnought Spawn | Silver Dragons | Invisible Stalkers
Monster (random creature): Beholder [solo] | Death Tyrant [solo] | Mind Flayer Arcanist | Ulitharid | Adult Red Dragon [solo] | Adult Gold Dragon [solo] | Kraken [solo] | Solar [solo] | Planetar [solo] | Archmage | Archdruid | Storm Giant Quintessent [solo]
description: This level was forged as an interdimensional vault and sanctuary to lock away artifacts capable of unmaking reality. It now serves as a cosmic battleground contested by githyanki knights, githzerai zerths, and enigmatic star spawn seers seeking ancient relics. The factions maintain perilous alliances with red dragons, silver dragons, and invisible stalkers to hold strategic portals across the void floor. Adventurers crossing this shattered vault are caught in the crossfire of a planar war, where they must choose a side, leverage cosmic secrets, or dodge ancient wardens and wandering aberrant horrors to escape with their lives.

name: The Infinite Sepulcher
walls: cyclopean marble shot through with glowing veins
ceilings: cathedral vault open to the void
Monster (pet or allied creature): Mind Flayer Arcanists | Boneclaws | Dracolich | Ghostly Knights
Monster (random creature): Tarrasque [solo] | Ancient Dragon Turtle [solo] | Empyrean [solo] | Solar [solo] | Pit Fiend [solo] | Balor [solo] | Kraken [solo] | Astral Dreadnought [solo] | Atropal [solo] | Nightwalker [solo] | Phoenix [solo] | Leviathan [solo]
description: The Infinite Sepulcher was erected as a grand monument and permanent resting place for reality-bending monarchs and archmages. It currently serves as a necromantic nexus dominated by supreme liches, renegade archmages, and demiliches who manipulate death magic to further their immortal agendas. These master spellcasters command bound dracoliches, mind flayer arcanists, and ghostly knights to defend their phylacteries and ancient knowledge. Players stepping into this void-touched cathedral must outwit cold, calculated intellects, navigating high-level magical warfare where every interaction is a puzzle designed to drain their souls or enslave them for eternity.

name: The Cosmic Fold
walls: impossible non-euclidean stone folding into itself
ceilings: cosmic void filled with drifting monoliths
Monster (pet or allied creature): Titanic Elementals | Mythic Fiends | Aspects of Bahamut | Aspects of Tiamat
Monster (random creature): Aspect of Tiamat [solo] | Aspect of Bahamut [solo] | Demon Lord [solo] | Archdevil [solo] | Greatwyrm Dragon [solo] | Primordial Elemental | Elder Tempest [solo] | Zaratan [solo] | Sibriex [solo] | Empyrean [solo] | Solar [solo] | Marut [solo]
description: The Cosmic Fold was created at the dawn of time as a grand gateway to stabilize the nexus between all existing planes. It now functions as an apocalyptic arena where ancient dragons, demon lords, and archdevils clash for absolute control over the cosmos. These divine and primordial beings command titanic elementals, mythic fiends, and avatars of dragon gods to reshape the shifting force plates of the level. Adventurers reaching this terminal depth face god-like powers in an environment that defies physics, forced to navigate world-ending rivalries where the slightest misstep means complete annihilation or cosmic subjugation.
